thread:
Anya (PM): quick sync — Customer 'Pathfinder' wants private on-prem pilot next quarter. Need to align runtime/infra/security for launch criteria + minimal scope. I sketched a proposal.
Sam (runtime): ok, what's the must-have vs nice-to-have? are they okay with quantized variants?
Anya (PM): must-have: VPC control plane, KMS/HSM integration, SLA for <200ms P95 for short chat flows. Nice-to-have: 8-bit quantization if it doesn't regress quality.
Devon (infra): capacity ask? GPUs? burst slots? we need numbers to reserve Dedicated pools.
Anya (PM): initial traffic estimate: 200 concurrent short sessions, avg 40 tok/session. Start with 4x A100-equivalent; plan for 2x burst. That's conservative.
Sam (runtime): note: 8-bit quant + KV cache warms differently. If we enable aggressive quant, we might lose prefix cache compatibility across model variants. Need a rollout plan that pins KV cache schema.
Kavi (eng): can we do model variant fallback? idea: primary=quantized-8, fallback=float16-hosted if QoL regressions flagged.
Lee (security): HSM integration timeline is the gating piece for enterprise contract. KMS-only is acceptable as interim for pilot but need audit logs and rotate-on-deploy. Is the customer OK with staged key posture?
Maria (prodops): staging plan: we need a private staging lane that mirrors customer network (VPC peering) + a prewarm job to populate KV cache before canary. Prewarm window candidate: 30m before first traffic window.
Anya (PM): propose launch criteria checklist: 1) HSM or KMS with rotation verified, 2) P95 <200ms on canary, 3) fallback path validated, 4) runbook + rollback owner assigned.
Devon (infra): +1. For capacity reservation, I'll provision 4 nodes in the sandbox. Need final commit by EOD Wed to hit vendor ordering SLA.
Sam (runtime): for the P95 target, we should test with prefix-heavy prompts. I'll add an eval job. Quick config sample for canary rollout:

```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 5%
  warmup: true
  prewarm_window: 1800 # seconds
  fallback: float16-hosted
  metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate, quality_delta]
```

Kavi (eng): suggested gating: quality_delta <= 1.5% on customer-specified eval set OR auto-rollback.
Lee (security): need audit log retention >= 90 days and HSM attestation doc before GA. For pilot KMS is fine if they sign a risk exception.
Anya (PM): owners: Devon -> infra capacity + staging, Sam -> runtime compatibility + evals, Lee -> security gating + docs, Maria -> runbook + rollout ops, Kavi -> fallback plumbing.
Devon (infra): noted. I'll start provisioning and post the infra ticket.
Maria (prodops): I'll schedule a 1-hour dry run next Tues. Can everyone confirm availability? 
Kavi (eng): can do. Sam? 
Sam (runtime): yes. I'll bring the eval outputs.
Lee (security): available but will need 30 mins pre-meet to review HSM artifacts.
Anya (PM): good. Final ask: everyone add any hard blockers to the infra ticket by EOD tomorrow. I'll consolidate into the launch checklist.

Anya (PM): thanks — will follow up with consolidated timeline + DOCS link once infra ticket is populated.
